findings.problem: Native IO action passes fresh time to client but does not freshly recheck operation deadline after older readiness selection; handshake-only client time does not enforce general request expiry.
findings.fix: Exclusive-driver fresh preflight checks scope/close latch and all active operation deadlines before bounded client IO; exact guard-removal mutant.

findings.problem: General driver errors returned to existing executor loops would be treated as idle; fail closed on an unexpected negative action refusal after valid engine selection.
findings.fix: Engine treats internal negative action result as invariant failure; user-facing errors are already scope-latched or terminal, and valid shortage returns zero.

findings.problem: Known CLUNK older-borrower shortage remained actionable during cancellation/whole close, causing repeated busy visits and an always-ready wait predicate.
findings.fix: Selector parks CANCEL and DISCARD until older FID borrows end; their actual return must wake the engine. Mutants independently remove each guard.
findings.test_review: Initial cancellation witness checked only visit return and missed a surviving mutant. Actual wait_arm immediate-work result now independently detects the defect; failed run preserved.
